notes:
LTTH Version 1.4.1 Release Notes

LTTH remains at 1.4.1 while the official plugin store publishes Stream Monsters 1.9.0 as an independent Open Beta plugin release.

- NEW: Rules v7 charges Specials passively during battle and explains every available skill in German, English, Spanish, and French
- NEW: Evolution II and III activate fixed, simulator-balanced element stats plus role-specific skill upgrades
- NEW: Evolution reveals animate every changed combat stat and newly unlocked skill beside the monster
- IMPROVED: Sealed A/B/C choices reveal simultaneously and interrupted reveals resume deterministically from persisted replay data
- IMPROVED: Elemental Hour explains its 30-second incubation reduction and +10 Hype without implying combat advantages
- IMPROVED: Creator demos cover the complete match, action, Special, knockout, evolution, and recovery presentation
- COMPATIBILITY: The stable streamalchemy plugin ID, player data, legacy replays, and every published Stream Monsters archive through 1.8.0 remain preserved
- RELEASE: streamalchemy-1.9.0.zip is built reproducibly from its recorded Git source and verified by SHA-256
